patterns_found.visual_evidence: Both sketches show a contact-style form with multiple labeled single-line inputs, a larger multiline message area, and a submit button beneath the fields.
patterns_found.behavior_notes: Required-field checking is implied before submission, especially for name/email/subject/message style fields. Email format validation is strongly implied by the contact-form layout. Inline error messaging and submit handling are needed.
patterns_found.ambiguities: The sketches do not show explicit error text, success state, or whether validation is inline-on-blur versus on-submit.

sketch_notes: The sketches imply a very low-JS page centered on a straightforward contact form rather than a highly interactive application. Across both mobile and desktop, the only clearly necessary JavaScript behavior is form submission support with validation and accessible error/focus handling. No convincing sketch evidence suggests menus, tabs, accordions, modals, sticky elements, search, or dynamic loading behaviors.
